purpose: One-shot engineering upgrade of the staged-candidate PRE realism layer from marginal sampling to class/style-conditioned multivariate dependence, then stop same-source realism tuning and seek external calibration/falsification.

known_before_v2_lock: v1 dramatically reduced linear/logistic distinguishability versus the staged source candidate.
v1 remained nonlinearly distinguishable: corrected scale-neutral fixed-HGB AUC about 0.821 and audit-view fixed-HGB AUC about 0.881.
post-result group diagnostics implicated multifeature tactical dependence rather than a single marginal feature.
large observed race-level Spearman gaps include makuri-vs-sashi, S-vs-sashi, B-vs-nige, and band/class-vs-nige relationships.
All of these are in-source staged-candidate diagnostics and not admitted real-world evidence.

one_shot_rule.next_realism_gain_after_v2: must come from independent time/source/official prospective calibration or falsification rather than repeated fitting to these same 1539 races

parameter_extraction_contract.candidate_subset: same 1539 standard-7 ordinary races / 10773 entrants used in v1 envelope
parameter_extraction_contract.rider_conditioning_cells: rider_class x style = 5 classes x 3 styles = 15 cells
parameter_extraction_contract.real_rate_transform: count / (wins + seconds + thirds + outs) when starts>0; starts=0 contributes zero tactical rate and is retained only with explicit quality accounting
parameter_extraction_contract.dependence_statistic: Spearman rank correlation within each rider_class x style cell
parameter_extraction_contract.runtime_recipe: For each class/style cell store score-to-tactical Gaussian correlations and a Cholesky factor of the conditional tactical covariance. Use the generated rider score latent as z_score, sample conditional correlated tactical normals, map through standard-normal CDF to the locked empirical quantile grid by linear interpolation.
parameter_extraction_contract.positive_semidefinite_policy: If numeric transformed correlation is not Cholesky-positive-definite, apply the smallest preregistered identity shrinkage from grid [0.00,0.01,0.02,...,0.50] that permits Cholesky; record shrinkage per cell. No post-result choice.
parameter_extraction_contract.score_class_structure: Derive within-race score residual mean by rider class and use it as a centered class offset while retaining the v1 race-band hierarchy. Offsets are recentered within each synthetic race so the race-level mean hierarchy is not silently shifted.
parameter_extraction_contract.style_line_coupling: retain v1 bounded assumption-shaped line-position/style coupling; line membership/order remains unavailable from this source and is not newly calibrated

v2_evaluation_contract.scale_neutral_erratum: Treat z-score mean/std as normalization identities and exclude them from corrected scale-neutral tree diagnostic; retain score_range.
v2_evaluation_contract.desired_engineering_direction: V2 fixed-HGB AUC should move closer to 0.5 than v1 without worsening source-boundary or firewall checks.
v2_evaluation_contract.reason_no_threshold: This is in-source engineering fit, not independent validation; arbitrary AUC pass thresholds would create false reality-equivalence semantics.
